label: Indicative 100 m² retirement home
description: A completed, move-in-ready two-bedroom residence for a retired couple, using an apartment, condominium, or the closest locally typical managed residence in an upper-middle-market neighborhood.
location_standard: Desirable year-round neighborhood within practical reach of healthcare, shops, and restaurants; excludes trophy waterfront, ski-in/ski-out, and ultra-prime addresses.
estimate_formula: destination usd_per_m2 benchmark multiplied by 100 m²
underlying_data_source: Manually curated destination market benchmarks originally embedded in artifacts/dashboard_mobile_first_v10.html and extracted into data/destinations.json. These are separate from the representative listing samples.
listing_source: Three manually curated public portal, brokerage, and market-report references per destination in data/listings.json, with source names, URLs, capture dates, and confidence notes.
fx_source: Fixed research snapshot in data/fx_rates.json; rates are not live.

fukuoka-itoshima.reason: Built-residential city benchmark; aligned by asset class, but not a quote for an exact two-bedroom home.

valencia.reason: Built-residential city asking-price benchmark; aligned by asset class and market segment.

algarve-cascais.reason: Blends two different regional price regimes and does not isolate managed two-bedroom residences.

malaga-costa-del-sol.reason: Blended mid-prime regional estimate with wide micro-location and property-type dispersion.

lake-como.reason: Regional built-property average does not isolate apartments from villas or prime lakefront stock.

hakone-izu.reason: Listing-led resort estimate mixes Hakone and Izu stock, age, condition, and property types.

madeira.reason: Quality-stock estimate with limited clean public comparables and no isolated archetype series.

costa-brava-girona.reason: Prime coastal location proxy; Girona city and managed-residence pricing differ materially.

crete.reason: Built-residential regional asking-price benchmark; aligned by asset class, subject to local variation.

hakuba.reason: Active chalet and house listings include land bundles and do not match a managed two-bedroom residence.

annecy.reason: Average built-property benchmark does not isolate apartment type, condition, or lake-location premium.

mallorca.reason: Underlying references mix houses, apartments, and island-wide second-hand pricing.

croatia-istria-dalmatia.reason: Coastal regional estimate spans Istria and Dalmatia and does not isolate the target residence.

niseko.reason: Hirafu condominium sales benchmark aligns with the managed-residence asset class, but remains resort-premium.

queenstown.reason: Uses average property value and high-end build-cost evidence rather than a sale-price-per-m² series.

phuket-koh-samui.reason: Blends condo and villa pricing across two islands with materially different tenure structures.

vancouver-island-victoria.reason: Broad regional built-residential price-per-square-foot estimate does not isolate the target residence.

dolomites-south-tyrol.reason: Premium Cortina/Dolomites benchmark is not representative of an upper-middle managed residence across South Tyrol.

bali.reason: Villa-led pricing and leasehold/freehold structures do not match a managed foreign-purchasable residence.

chamonix.reason: Average built-property benchmark does not isolate a two-bedroom managed residence or exclude chalet stock.

park-city-deer-valley.reason: Luxury resort benchmark blends housing types and submarkets rather than a two-bedroom managed residence.

da-nang-hoi-an.reason: Foreign-accessible apartment benchmark aligns with the target asset class, subject to project and title checks.

whistler.reason: Midpoint of a broad resort price-per-square-foot range does not isolate the target residence.

andermatt.reason: Premium resort benchmark is higher-end than the upper-middle archetype and needs unit-level confirmation.

innsbruck-tyrol.reason: Built-apartment benchmark aligns with the target asset class, subject to foreign-buyer eligibility.

lake-tahoe.reason: Blended prime resort benchmark spans states, housing types, and waterfront exposure.

jackson-hole.reason: Prime built-property benchmark reflects opaque and mixed resort stock rather than the target residence.

ticino-lake-lugano.reason: Average property benchmark does not isolate apartments or confirm foreign-purchasable inventory.

aspen-snowmass.reason: Prime single-family benchmark is materially above and different from the managed-residence archetype.

swiss-valais-vaud-alps.reason: Premium alpine benchmark spans resorts and does not isolate eligible upper-middle managed residences.

dubai.reason: Broad apartment market data and current asking observations mix ready and off-plan submarkets rather than isolating the target completed residence.

gold-coast-sunshine-coast.reason: A single new-apartment asking observation is not a completed-sale valuation or a regional upper-middle resale benchmark.

los-angeles-orange-county.reason: A Santa Monica asking observation and wider regional comparables do not isolate a representative two-bedroom resale benchmark across both counties.

miami-fort-lauderdale.reason: Three asking listings across distinct submarkets are not a completed-sale valuation or a representative regional benchmark.

perth-margaret-river.reason: A small new-build asking sample across urban and regional submarkets is not a resale market median or valuation.

sydney-melbourne.reason: Three new-development asking observations across two cities do not represent a completed-resale upper-middle benchmark.

vancouver.reason: A Yaletown asking observation and mixed property-type comparables do not isolate the target residence across the Vancouver market.

excluded_costs: legal, notary, registration, and agent fees
renovation, furnishing, and ongoing ownership costs
